data.title: SaverOne Expands Collaboration with Cemex Germany to Heavy Trucks
data.description: Installation of the initial phase for the expansion of SaverOne's presence in Europe has been finished on Cemex Germany’s truck fleet. This marks a significant step forward in the planned rollout, enhancing SaverOne’s reach in the region. This first phase completion encompasses a substantial number of trucks, showcasing a strong start to the initiative.

data.title: Powerhouse Appoints Sue McCarty as Chief Revenue Officer and Justin Figley as Chief Operating Officer
data.description: Powerhouse, a prominent company specializing in multi-site rollout, refresh, staffing, and merchandising solutions based in Crowley, Texas, recently disclosed significant leadership changes. Sue McCarty has been appointed as the Chief Revenue Officer, while Justin Figley has assumed the role of Chief Operating Officer. These promotions highlight the exceptional performance and dedication of both individuals, whose professional journeys have largely been dedicated to Powerhouse's operations division. According to Michael Wroughton, the Chief Executive Officer at Powerhouse, "Sue and Justin have significantly contributed to advancing Powerhouse's growth and success from within."

data.title: Buywander, Auction Marketplace for Returned Goods, Raises $21M in Series A Funding
data.description: Seattle-based company Buywander, known for its auction-based marketplace specializing in returned and overstocked retail inventory, has recently disclosed the successful completion of a $21 million Series A funding round. This recent funding injection has propelled the total lifetime funding of the company to $28 million. The funding round was spearheaded by Madrona Venture Group and Inspired Capital, with continued support from previous investors including Triple Impact Capital, Silence Ventures, Data Tech Fund, and Animal Capital, among others, as well as contributions from a cohort of angel investors. The acknowledgment of billions of dollars' worth of returned and surplus inventory held by retailers underscores the significance of Buywander's platform in addressing this notable industry challenge.

data.title: Smart Care Launches Turbo Tech for Speed Ovens and Coffee Equipment, Debuts Innovative Flat Rate Pricing for Speed Ovens Service
data.description: A company based in Chicago, Smart Care, has introduced a new service called Turbo Tech aimed at enhancing the performance of speed ovens and coffee equipment. The service includes innovative flat rate pricing for maintenance and repair of speed ovens. This initiative is expected to streamline the process and ensure quicker servicing of equipment.

data.title: ‘Experience All Things K-Style in Mexico’ 2026 K-EXPO MEXICO to Open at WTC CIEC on September 24
data.description: A major event, 2026 K-EXPO MEXICO, is scheduled to take place in Mexico City from September 24 to 27 this year. The expo aims to attract a significant number of attendees and participants.

data.title: Creating Safe Spaces for Brighter Futures
data.description: Blue Shield Promise is offering free annual memberships to the Boys & Girls Clubs of Greater San Diego to youth members aged 5 to 14. The initiative aims to support children like Miguel, who faced difficulties in social settings. This program, starting September 15, 2026, will benefit a significant number of youngsters in the community, providing them with opportunities for growth and connection.

data.title: Pediatric Vaccines Market: USD 56.06 Billion by 2031, Growth Fueled by Multivalent Formulations and Next-Generation Vaccine Platforms, Says Mordor Intelligence
data.description: In Hyderabad, India, as of September 15, 2026, a recent study by Mordor Intelligence reveals that the pediatric vaccines market is valued at approximately USD 42.53 billion for the year. The market is expected to grow significantly, reaching around USD 56.06 billion by 2031, showing a Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) of 5.68% throughout the forecast period.

data.title: In HelloNation, Sleep Apnea Expert Dr. Robert Spoont Examines Oral Appliance Therapy for Sleep Apnea Relief
data.description: A recent report delves into the advantages of a personalized mouthpiece in improving breathing and enhancing sleep quality without invasive methods. Coming out of Boca Raton, Florida on September 15, 2026, the study highlights the benefits of oral appliance therapy in tackling sleep apnea effectively. Provided through HelloNation, the findings shed light on how this treatment can significantly improve the sleep patterns of individuals.

data.title: HealthIQ Solutions and Eirion.ai Form Strategic Technology Innovation Partnership to Pioneer Predictive AI in Remote Care Management
data.description: A partnership has been formed with the goal of providing cutting-edge clinical risk prediction for serious medical conditions, giving doctors the ability to take action before harmful incidents occur. The collaboration was announced in Roswell, Georgia on September 15, 2026. HealthIQ Solutions, LLC, known for its forward-thinking approach to remote care management, is leading this initiative.

data.title: Transient Secures Investment from Nasdaq Ventures to Advance Bank-Grade Governance for Enterprise AI
data.description: In New York, Transient.AI (Transient), a secure AI operating system for regulated markets, revealed a significant development - Nasdaq Ventures has strategically invested in the company. This collaboration with lead investor NEXT Investors as part of its Series A funding signifies a crucial step for Transient in providing bank-grade, policy-driven AI governance for regulated financial entities worldwide. As global financial authorities deliberate on the potential dangers and alignment issues, this investment highlights a key milestone for Transient in its mission.

data.title: Topcon and Proceq Announce Collaboration for Subsurface Intelligence Applications in EMEA
data.description: A partnership has been announced between Topcon Positioning Systems and Proceq, a Screening Eagle Company, to integrate Proceq's advanced ground penetrating radar (GPR) systems with Topcon GNSS solutions and mass data workflow software. This collaboration aims to enhance applications in infrastructure and construction projects in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). Proceq brings cutting-edge GPR technology to the table, facilitating advanced capabilities in this field through this joint effort. The collaboration is set to benefit various projects in EMEA, leveraging the expertise of both companies to deliver innovative solutions.

data.title: Exyn Technologies Extends ExynAI Autonomy to CHCNAV’s X500 Drone, Expanding Its Third-Party Robotics Ecosystem
data.description: The integration has enabled Exyn to achieve close to half an hour of autonomous flight in environments lacking GPS coverage. This advancement supports Exyn's strategy to make ExynAI compatible with various aerial and ground platforms, further broadening its application range.

data.title: Forward Industries Announces Updated Proposal to Acquire SkyAI, Inc.
data.description: The offer presents a 50% increase from SkyAI's ending price on September 14, 2026. Shareholders of SkyAI have the option to choose between cash, Forward common stock, or a mix of both in the proposal.

data.title: Caddo Appoints Peyton Weeks as New President
data.description: Caddo Sustainable Timberlands, LP, the leading private timberland owner in Texas, has appointed Peyton Weeks as President. With over 25 years of experience in timberland management and wood products manufacturing in Texas and Louisiana, Peyton joins from Weyerhaeuser. At Weyerhaeuser, Peyton held several leadership positions since 2002, overseeing almost 500,000 acres in East Texas. This move signals Caddo’s commitment to further growth and diversification under Peyton’s seasoned leadership.

data.title: U. S. Steel Receives Final Required Permit for State-of-the-Art Quench and Tempering Facility at Fairfield Tubular Operations
data.description: In Birmingham, Alabama, U.S. Steel has obtained the required permit to proceed with the construction of a new quench and tempering facility at its Fairfield Tubular Operations. This development is crucial for the company's expansion plans and signifies a significant investment in the local area. The facility is expected to create numerous job opportunities and inject a substantial amount of capital into the community. This progress highlights U.S. Steel's commitment to growth and development within the region.

data.title: Dr. Keith Harris To Be Inaugurated as President of Freed-Hardeman University
data.description: In Henderson, Tennessee, on September 15, 2026, Freed-Hardeman University announced the appointment of Dr. Keith Harris as the institution's 17th president. With a history spanning 157 years, the university is set to embark on a new era under his leadership. The official inauguration ceremony is scheduled for Thursday, October 22, with a 10:30 AM gathering of students, faculty, staff, alumni, and distinguished guests.

data.title: CoreFX Expands Global Reach with New European Innovation Headquarters in Ireland, Supported by Enterprise Ireland
data.description: CoreFX is set to open a new headquarters in Europe to support its existing U.S. operations. This move aims to quicken the advancement of the company's exclusive CoreNhanced™ platform. It will also enhance scientific partnerships and drive commercial expansion in Europe. The new headquarters will be located in County Cork, Ireland, and is anticipated to boost growth significantly. This strategic decision comes after CoreFX's success in the U.S. and will mark a significant milestone in the company's expansion plans.
